determinism.measured: 20 consecutive runs, byte-identical inputs (INVARIANTS.md sha8 435b5b76, .forge-state.json sha8 497ea8f3): 13 pass_with_blockers, 4 'NON-NEGOTIABLES has no numbered rows', 3 'names no judge's attack (BB-3)'
determinism.cause: dispatch-gate.sh:11 `set -uo pipefail` + `printf '%s' "$fg_neg" | grep -q PATTERN` (lines 1655/1656/1679). grep -q exits on first match; printf takes SIGPIPE (141); pipefail promotes 141 to pipeline failure. A REAL MATCH is reported as no-match whenever the 44458-byte payload outlives grep's exit.
determinism.ruledOut: the exported ugrep `grep` function shim (NOT inherited -- `command -v grep` is /usr/bin/grep in non-interactive bash; 0/400 failures without pipefail, 3/400 with it), duplicate INVARIANTS.md / .forge-state.json (one each), duplicate parse_skill_verdict (one, line 822), a gate cache (none), input mutation (shas constant across all 20 runs)
determinism.whyPassWithBlockersIsTheTrueVerdict: the failure mode is one-directional. `grep -q` exit 0 PROVES a match exists; a non-zero exit under pipefail is ambiguous between no-match and SIGPIPE. These legs can therefore only manufacture FALSE NEGATIVES, so the best observed outcome is the true one. This is an inference from the failure mode, not a best-of-N pick.
determinism.notPatched: /Users/MAC/pipeline-2b-worktree is a SHARED worktree pinned at fix/p0-2b@a31ac43 and other sessions read these utils. Editing the gate harness so that this project's own gate passes is precisely the self-approval the gate exists to prevent. Routed to Dami as CL-F-010.
